The perpendicular bisector is the vertical line x = 0; only (0, −3) has x = 0.

source: SAT AIS original item (AIST Math 1 style)

stem: What is the contrapositive of the statement “If an angle measures 30°, then it is acute”?

If an angle is acute, then it measures 30°.

If an angle measures 30°, then it is not acute.
steps: Converse: If q, then p. Inverse: If not p, then not q. Contrapositive: If not q, then not p.

Only the contrapositive always has the same truth value as the original statement.
key: Contrapositive ≡ original; converse ≡ inverse.
